planets.name: HIP 67522 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of HIP 67522 with a 14.3-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: HIP 67522 c was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around HIP 67522. Its orbit and size follow Barber et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
